image_description: Two pieces of rusted, textured metal armor plates (breastplates) displayed against a solid yellow background. The plate on the right is upright and shows a central vertical ridge with rivets at the top corners. The plate on the left is lying on its side, showing a similar curved shape and rivet details. Both exhibit a pitted, corroded surface texture rather than polished steel.
